title: Flowchart of the Statistical Drake Equation derivation steps
description: Uncaptioned flowchart of boxed steps from '1. Introduction' through 'Step 1: Letting each factor become a random' and 'Step 7: Finding the probability density function of N, but only numerically', which ends at a 'DEAD END!' box. A parallel branch runs from '4. The Central Limit Theorem (CLT) of Statistics' through lognormal distribution, distance to the nearest ExtraTerrestrial civilization ('the Maccone distribution') to '8. DATA ENRICHMENT PRINCIPLE as the best CLT consequence upon the Drake equation'.
